description: Elections Commission - Parliamentary Elections Act. No 01 of 1981 Filling of a Vacancy under Section 64 (5)
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively concerns the process of filling a vacancy in Parliament due to a member's resignation, as per the Parliamentary Elections Act. It details the notification from the Secretary General of Parliament, the nomination by a political party, and the formal declaration by the Election Commission. This falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations, making it an **Elections Gazette (Type 7)**. While it names individuals, the core subject is an electoral procedure, not a government personnel appointment or restructuring (Types 1-3).
